newsitem.title: USA: Michael Jackson is father - official.
newsitem.headline: Michael Jackson is father - official.

text.p: Michael Jackson, the self-styled "King of Pop", became a father for the first time on Thursday and appealed to fans to let his new son grow up away from the "fish bowl" Jackson himself lived in as a child star.
"Michael Jackson and his wife Debbie are proud parents of a baby boy, born today at Cedars-Sinai hospital in Los Angeles," said a statement from his publicist Bob Jones.
"Mother and baby are doing fine," said the release which revealed no further details, such as what time the birth occurred, how much the baby weighed and what its name will be.
"Words can't describe how I feel," Jackson was quoted as saying in the statement that referred to him as "The King of Pop".
"I have been blessed beyond comprehension and I will work tirelessly at being the best father that I can possibly be," Jackson said.
He then went on to appeal for privacy for his son, who was believed to have been born in the early hours, since mother and baby left the hospital around 8 a.m.
"I appreciate that my fans are elated, but I hope that everyone respects the privacy that Debbie and I want and need for our son.
"I grew up in a 'fish bowl' and will not allow that to happen to my child. Please respect our wishes and give my son his privacy," said Jackson.
The child, Jackson's first, was born at Cedars-Sinai Medical Centre in Beverly Hills. Jackson's wife of three months, Debbie Rowe, left the hospital with her baby at around 8 a.m. PST (1600 GMT).

"They're both doing fine," said hospital spokesman Ron Wise, who had not even confirmed Jackson's wife was in the hospital on Wednesday. Wise said he did not know if the reclusive 38-year-old entertainer accompanied his wife and son from the hospital.
"Mr. and Mrs. Jackson have requested that there be no further information other than that the baby was a boy and mother and son are doing fine."

Despite the mob of reporters, photographers and television camera crews who had spent an all-night vigil outside the hospital, Jackson's wife and her baby were spirited away without any media seeing them.
Jackson announced that his then wife-to-be was six months pregnant just 10 days before they were married last November in Sydney, Australia, where he was on tour.

The "Gloved One," as he is often called because of his trademark single glove, has reportedly said he will name his son Michael Jackson Jr. and that his long-time friend, movie star Elizabeth Taylor, would be the boy's godmother.
Jackson was previously married to Lisa Marie Presley, daughter of rock 'n' roll legend Elvis Presley, for 20 months. He married Rowe less than a year after the divorce.
Jackson and Rowe have known each other for several years. They met when she worked as a nurse in the office of the singer's Beverly Hills dermatologist.
Jackson denied tabloid newspaper reports that Rowe had been artificially inseminated, that he paid her $500,000 to have his child and that he would pay her $1.24 million when the baby was born.
Jackson's fame and controversial lifestyle have kept him in the headlines for years. Before he married Presley he was accused of sexual molestation by a 13-year-old boy.

He agreed to a reported multimillion-dollar settlement of the boy's civil lawsuit while strenuously denying the allegations. The case was investigated by prosecutors in Los Angeles and Santa Barbara but no criminal charges were filed.
